diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: The Islamic Republic has added 11 more ships to the blacklist of vessels passing through the Strait of Hormuz. The total number of ships on this list has reached 56. Ships on this list may face fines, detention, or confiscation.

Ynet reported that oil tankers, with the support of the US Navy, mostly transit the Strait of Hormuz at night and with their automatic identification systems turned off to reduce the risk of attacks by the Islamic Republic. They then transfer their cargo to other ships in the Gulf of Oman.

Donald Trump stated that the US has very strong control over the Strait of Hormuz and millions of barrels of oil pass through it daily. He said the Islamic Republic fires drones and missiles that the US shoots down and has targeted Iran's missile systems. Trump also reported a missile attack on a US base in Jordan and the American forces' response.

Richard Marles, Australia's defense minister, said in Washington that Iran's action to restrict shipping in the Strait of Hormuz violates the UN convention and the passage must be reopened. He emphasized the importance of keeping the Strait of Hormuz open and restoring global fuel supply chains to normal. Marles also called for a reduction of tensions in the Middle East.

An emergency alert has been issued in Kuwait due to a security threat. People are advised to stay in safe places and avoid windows and open spaces. The alert was announced by Civil Defense and the Ministry of Interior.

Donald Trump stated that the US is winning the war against the Islamic Republic by a large margin. He said recent US attacks have caused extensive damage to Iran's military capabilities and that Iran's economy is in a critical state. Trump also emphasized that the US controls the Strait of Hormuz.

The Wall Street Journal reported that US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth has extended the deployment of some American forces in the Middle East until 2027. Approximately 50,000 US troops remain in the region, with missions including intercepting Islamic Republic missiles, protecting commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, and enforcing a blockade of Iran. The newspaper also wrote that Donald Trump believes continued economic pressure could force the Islamic Republic to dismantle its nuclear program or lead to the regime's collapse.

Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, said Russia's aid to the Islamic Republic does not prevent Washington's ability to protect itself. He added that the US and Russia are not aligned on Iran. Moscow remains heavily focused on its war in Ukraine.

Prince Reza Pahlavi plans to travel to Australia and request the closure of the Iranian embassy in Canberra. He also calls for increased actions against networks linked to the IRGC. The trip date is not yet confirmed, and he will first hold virtual talks with Australian lawmakers.

Hossein Shariatmadari called on the army and the IRGC to use the international fiber optic cables in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz to confront the US and its allies. He emphasized that these cables are the main routes for internet communications and international transactions. Shariatmadari told officials not to forget the role of these cables in the conflict.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, warned that Washington's message to all countries, including Russia, is to distance themselves from the Islamic Republic and not support Tehran. This message aims to prevent international support for the Islamic Republic. The report was prepared by Maryam Rahmati from Iran International.

Sadegh Beigdelie said the short-term goal of the US is to weaken the Islamic Republic and force Tehran to reach an agreement. He added that in the long term, the US seeks to change Iran's position in the global order. Beigdelie also pointed to signs of economic collapse in Iran.

Donald Trump, the President of the United States, said the US has very firm control over the Strait of Hormuz, and ships carrying millions of barrels of oil pass through this waterway daily. He added that these operations are mostly carried out without issue, and American forces shoot down drones that the Islamic Republic sends to confront them.

The United Arab Emirates condemned the Islamic Republic's attack on a Saudi oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, which resulted in the death of two sailors. The UAE Foreign Ministry also condemned missile attacks by the Islamic Republic on Bahrain, Kuwait, Jordan, and the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. Previously, several regional countries had described these attacks as a threat to regional security.

Farzin Nadimi commented on the extension of the US forces' mission in the region until 2027. He said maintaining about 50,000 US troops and military equipment indicates the Pentagon's readiness to continue its military presence. This was stated in an interview with Iran International.

The sentence of Sadegh Saedinia, CEO of Saedinia Properties and Industries, was confirmed by the Supreme Court. He was sentenced to 12 years, 6 months, and one day of imprisonment and confiscation of all movable and immovable property. He was also banned from working in the cafe business for two years after serving his sentence.

A citizen sent a video showing the deployment of a missile launcher in the Abuzar neighborhood of Mashhad. The video was sent to Iran International on the evening of Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar. The location of the launcher deployment in this neighborhood is shown.

Esmail Kowsari praised the nightly gatherings of government supporters in city squares. He said that despite economic problems, people come to the squares more energetically each night. This presence has disappointed the enemy.

The NBA fined the Los Angeles Clippers 30 million dollars for violations in the Kawhi Leonard case. The Clippers were also stripped of five first-round draft picks from 2029 to 2033, and two club executives were suspended. Kawhi Leonard was fined $700,000 and accepted responsibility.

A video shared on social media shows an increase in gold prices in a market. A citizen stated that the price of one gram of gold has reached 23,291,000 tomans. This price has surpassed 23 million tomans.

Mohammad Javad Akbarin explained Trump's claim about monitoring the Islamic Republic's movements is partly based on recent war experiences. He believes the regional crisis is not yet uncontrollable. There is no sign of the Islamic Republic finding a way out of economic and political crises.

Ali Shirazi from Iran International explained the threat by Hossein Shariatmadari to attack submarine cables and fiber optics in the Strait of Hormuz. This threat was raised in response to economic pressures and claims about the ineffectiveness of closing the strait. Attacking communication infrastructure could provoke a broad international reaction.

Tiger Woods reached an agreement with Florida prosecutors and accepted the reckless driving charge. His driver's license will be suspended for five years and he will pay a $1,000 fine. The charge of driving under the influence was dropped.

Qatar's Foreign Ministry condemned the Islamic Republic's attacks on Kuwait as a violation of Kuwait's sovereignty. The ministry stated that continuing these attacks escalates tensions and undermines regional security efforts. Qatar held the Islamic Republic legally responsible and expressed full support for Kuwait.

The group stage draw of the AFC Champions League was held, and Khatun Bam was placed in Group A with Nagawhyang North Korea, Leonessa Kobe Japan, and Ayody Myanmar. Nagawhyang North Korea is the defending champion. The group stage will be held from October 31 to November 7.

Adel Matlibnejad's sister commemorated him in a video message. Matlibnejad was killed on January 9, 2026, in Baharestan Square, Isfahan, by three bullets. His body was delivered a week later after the family gave a commitment.

The price of the British pound in Iran's free market surpassed 300,000 tomans for the first time, reaching 300,280 tomans. The dollar was traded above 222,000 tomans and the euro above 258,000 tomans. Additionally, the price of the Emami coin exceeded 235 million tomans.

Tehran's prosecutor announced charges against the staff and officials of Didar News for publishing false and insulting content. A legal case has been filed regarding this matter. The charges relate to one of the internet programs of this media outlet.

After the draw in the match against Persepolis, Esteghlal club officially complained to the referees committee. Esteghlal pointed to three incidents where Persepolis players should have been sent off for fouls. The club also protested the referee's performance and the silence of the VAR room, requesting serious action from the referees committee.

The Iranian army's public relations claimed attacks on the Ahmad Al-Jaber base in Kuwait and the Al-Minhad base in the UAE using missiles and drones. These attacks are said to continue against US bases. Any US attack will be met with a hard and devastating response.
A citizen sent a video showing supporters of the government waving flags in a street darkened by a power outage. He criticized this behavior, saying these people deserve the current situation.

Family and friends of Milad Mianehkhah Monfaredi, a former youth player of Malavan club, held his 30th birthday celebration at his grave. Milad was killed on January 9, 2026, during the Iranian National Revolution in Bandar Anzali. He was shot by the suppressive forces of the Islamic Republic.

Former parliament deputy speaker Ali Motahhari said that the Islamic Republic and the United States have no choice but to reach an understanding and agreement. He said the best option is to return to the agreement and that the US must be forced to do so. Motahhari also said that Trump's remarks about abandoning the agreement should not be taken seriously.

The head of the health network in Gachsaran reported the aging of part of the emergency fleet in the county. Only two out of four ambulances are operational, and both require major repairs. Gachsaran needs four new ambulances for road fleet reinforcement, estimated to cost about 80 billion tomans.

After a missile hit a wedding ceremony in Kuhestak Sirik, the Islamic Republic accused the US of targeting civilians. Tehran's representative at the UN called the attack a war crime. CENTCOM stated it is investigating the incident and emphasized that the US military never targets civilians.

Citizens have reported water shortages and tree drying in Chitgar Park. Reza Bayani, the director general of natural resources in Tehran province, announced the formation of a legal case regarding the cutting of thousands of trees in the park. The issue is currently under investigation.

Babak Sadeghi Mohseni's sister joined the memorial campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" and called for preserving the memory of the immortal. Babak Sadeghi Mohseni died on January 9, 2026, in Tehran from a direct gunshot. He was born in 1994 in Karaj and lived in Hamedan.

Sima Sabto and Nahid Falahati, Bahá'í citizens residing in Shiraz, have been detained and in legal limbo for over 70 days in Adelabad Prison. They are deprived of the possibility to contact or meet their families. The situation has been reported by the HRANA news agency.

Missile and drone threats from the Islamic Republic have pushed Gulf countries to strengthen their defense capabilities and produce drones. The Samafor website reported that a factory near Riyadh is being built to produce drones inspired by the Islamic Republic's Shahed drone.

Israel's Defense Minister Yisrael Katz stated that if the Islamic Republic attacks Israel, the country will target all infrastructures including energy. He warned that economic pressure might drive Iran to desperate actions. Katz emphasized that Iran has so far refrained from attacking Israel for specific reasons.
A citizen sent a video showing a fire in the trees at Shindan beach in Astara. The incident occurred on Thursday, 12 Shahrivar. The video was sent to Iran International.

Emmanuel Macron will meet with the new British Prime Minister Andy Burnham in his first visit to the UK since Burnham took office. They will discuss migrants in the English Channel, defense and economic cooperation, support for Ukraine, and Middle East developments. The meeting will take place at 10 Downing Street.

The Islamic Republic Army announced that it targeted US military bases in the UAE and Kuwait with missiles and drones. The targets included satellite communication systems, equipment warehouses, and fighter aircraft hangars. This action is part of ongoing tensions and reciprocal attacks with the US.

Saudi Arabia is building a factory near Riyadh to produce a drone similar to the Islamic Republic's "Shahed." The "Sky Wasp" drone will be produced in cooperation with an American and a Saudi company. Its range has been announced to be up to 1,500 kilometers.

A video on social media shows long lines of cars waiting for gasoline in Mashhad. A citizen in the video sarcastically comments on the issued rulings for protesters, saying, "Even if we swear, we become agents of Mossad."

The Ghana Football Federation has extended the contract of Carlos Queiroz, the Portuguese head coach of the national team. Previous financial issues were resolved with the help of Ghana's Ministry of Sports, allowing Queiroz to continue leading the team. Queiroz led Ghana to the round of 16 in the 2026 World Cup.

Voria Ghafouri announced in the 360 program that Yaser Asani has prepared a house for an Iranian. Asani scored the equalizing goal for Esteghlal against Persepolis in Derby 107. This news was mentioned in the special derby program.

Videos received by Iran International indicate an intensifying fuel crisis and very long queues at fuel stations in various Iranian cities. Reports from the public suggest that the queues sometimes last until late at night. Baharan Azadi, a member of Iran International's editorial team, has provided more details.

Saipa company has significantly increased the prices of four products due to higher costs of scrap certificates and legal fees. The prices of Quick S and Sahand S dual-fuel have each risen by 33 million tomans. Additionally, the prices of assembled and imported cars like Citroen C3-XR and Changan CS55 Plus have increased by 115 and 198 million tomans respectively.

The sister of Mojtaba Roostaei lit a candle in memory of her brother and the missing persons of Malayer by joining the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." Mojtaba Roostaei was killed by officers' gunfire on January 9, 2026.

Tasnim News Agency reported the killing of three Iranian army pilots in the US attack on Tuesday night. Two of the pilots were from the Navy and one from the Air Force. The attacks targeted various areas in Iran, including Jiroft airport and cities in Khuzestan.

Amir Ali Ghanbarzadeh, a youth basketball player, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Garmdareh, Alborz province. He died after being shot three times in the head during protests. His mother expressed her grief and loss in a video.
A video on social media shows a shopkeeper protesting the daily increase in cooking oil prices. He says the price of this product is rising every day. People blame the shopkeepers for this increase.

The police commander of Bandar Anzali announced the arrest of a citizen in the city. The arrest was due to the publication of insulting and false content on an Instagram page. The individual is accused of disturbing public opinion.

Donald Trump announced that the volume of oil transit through the Strait of Hormuz has returned to near pre-war levels. This news was published on Truth Social. Maryam Rahmati from Iran International reports on the latest developments in the US regarding tensions with the Islamic Republic.

Mohammad Nazifi, CEO of the Energy Exchange, mentioned challenges in the country's oil sales and transaction settlements. He stated that export oil sales can be conducted through the Energy Exchange, which can also help finance the development of oil and gas industries. Nazifi hopes the Ministry of Oil will take steps to utilize the Energy Exchange's capacity.

The head of Iran's AIDS Research Center announced that sexual transmission has become the main route of HIV infection. In 1404, about 65% of new cases were identified through sexual contact. A significant portion of these cases involved sexual relations between men.

The Free Iran and European Union conference will be held in Düsseldorf, Germany. The main topics include the outlook for a free and democratic Iran, economic capacities and investment, and future cooperation between Iran and the EU. Legal and political issues during the transition period will also be discussed.

The deputy of training and education of the Islamic Republic Army stated that the military doctrine is defensive, but the capability and training for preemptive attacks exist. Penetration and attack trainings have been provided across various army forces and are executable. Experiences from the 12-day war were applied in the 40-day war.

Mahdeseh Shahbazi, 20 years old, was killed by direct gunfire from government suppression forces in Tehran on January 9, 2026. A video has been released showing her father at her grave. He expresses his sorrow over her absence.

Luis Enrique, the coach of Paris Saint-Germain, praised the club's performance in the transfer market as exceptional. He thanked the club's managers and departing players and explained the departure of Bradley Barcola. Enrique believes the new signings have strengthened the team's attacking line.

Manouchehr Motaki stated that the Islamic Republic's armed forces will make the Omani route of the Strait of Hormuz unsafe for the United States. He also emphasized that nuclear enrichment will not be relinquished. Motaki outlined the conditions for the US to return to negotiations with Tehran.

The funeral ceremony of Farahnaz Espad, a journalist and presenter at Iran International, was held in London. She passed away at the age of 37 after battling cancer for two years. Espad had been collaborating with Iran International for eight years.

Mohammad Reza Aref stated that recent US actions against Iran have changed the security equations and defense doctrine of the Islamic Republic. He said Iran's response will be disproportionate, multilayered, and security-denying to the aggressor. He also warned that dark months await the US economy.

A citizen reported in a video to Iran International that drug prices in Iran have doubled within one month. This highlights the ongoing inflation in the country. The report concerns the economic and pharmaceutical situation in Iran.

Spanish police clashed with protesters in Madrid on Wednesday, September 2, and dispersed them. The protesters demanded stricter border controls. Official statistics on detainees or injuries have not yet been released.
A human rights group in Germany has filed a criminal complaint. They have called for an investigation into crimes against humanity in Iran. This action was taken by the human rights group.

Mohammad Reza Aref, the First Vice President of the Islamic Republic of Iran, warned on Thursday, 12 Shahrivar, that 'dark months' await the United States economy and called on the American people to stockpile fuel and gasoline. He emphasized that 'America's new crimes' have changed its defense doctrine to 'unbalanced' and 'multi-layered' tactics.

Mike Huckabee, the US ambassador to Israel, stated that progress toward peace between Israel and Lebanon will happen only when Hezbollah is removed. These remarks came after Israel decided to release five Lebanese citizens and amid efforts to find remains of Jews killed in Lebanon. Additionally, Israel's defense minister and chief of staff held a meeting to assess the security situation.

The funeral ceremony of Farahnaz Espad, journalist and presenter of Iran International, was held on Thursday morning, 12 Shahrivar, in London. The ceremony was attended by her husband and dozens of journalists and civil activists at a cemetery in the British capital. The event was held in her memory.

The "Justice Beyond Borders" meeting was held in Berlin to examine legal ways in Germany and the EU to hold perpetrators of human rights violations in Iran accountable. Ahmad Samadi, a reporter for Iran International, covered the event. An interview was also conducted with Sina Yousefi, a lawyer and vice president of the Human Rights Commission.

Farhad Amani's mother lit a candle in memory of her son by joining the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory." Farhad Amani, 25, was shot and killed on January 8, 2026, in the Punak neighborhood of Tehran. His mother emphasized that their memory should not be forgotten.

Saeed Ghaseminejad stated that the top priority after passing the Islamic Republic is to rebuild the country's security system. This reconstruction will include military, food, energy, and infrastructure security. Efforts will also be made to lift all sanctions imposed on Iran.

Donald Trump, the US President, criticized media outlets on Truth Social for failing to accurately report on US military operations in Iran. He stated that the US possesses an almost unlimited supply of medium to high-quality ammunition and is currently producing ammunition at an unprecedented level. Trump also noted that the Joe Biden administration provided Ukraine with significantly more ammunition without charge.

Donald Trump stated that the US has virtually unlimited amounts of medium-to-high-quality munitions and is producing them at an unprecedented level. He said the munitions are being kept for the United States, but sales to allies will resume soon. Trump also claimed the Biden administration gave hundreds of billions of dollars in free munitions to Ukraine.

Farshad Momeni stated that the poor population in Iran has doubled over the past three years. He described this trend alongside increasing inequality as one of the most serious economic and social issues in the country. Momeni questioned why no significant changes have been made in economic policies despite this situation.

The Joint Maritime Information Center reported that attacks and efforts by the IRGC to target or disrupt shipping in the Strait of Hormuz continue. Commercial traffic in the area remains below normal levels, with single-digit numbers of ships passing through. Additionally, two crew members were killed in an attack on the tanker "Sider."

A truck driver told Iran International in a video that the Islamic Republic is smuggling fuel to neighboring countries. This smuggling is done by land. According to him, this is the reason for the fuel shortage inside the country.

The US Central Command announced that more than 2,600 soldiers and marines are stationed on the USS Boxer warship in the Middle East. These forces are carrying out their operational duties alongside the amphibious mission of the Boxer. CENTCOM has shared images and details of the marines' activities on the ship.
The police commander of Abadan announced the arrest of an Instagram page admin. The page was blocked by judicial order. The page was accused of publishing indecent content and inappropriate images.

Alireza Beiranvand, the national football team goalkeeper, stated that he does not intend to retire from the national team. He said his aspirations are set on the World Cup and if he does not get injured, he will be part of the 2030 World Cup team.

On the night of 10 Shahrivar 1405, concurrent with US airstrikes on Sirik, an explosion destroyed a house in Bandar-e Kuhestak where a wedding was taking place. According to reports, five people, including a four-year-old child, died and 65 were injured. Evidence such as CCTV footage and a CENTCOM statement strengthens the attribution to the US, but it is still unclear what projectile hit the house.

Reuters, citing three senior sources in the Islamic Republic, reported that economic pressure from the naval blockade and US sanctions has reached a level that is difficult for the government to bear. Iran's crude oil loading has dropped to about 260,000 barrels per day this month. Additionally, the United Arab Emirates has suspended all trade and financial transactions with the Islamic Republic.

The Maku Civil Registration Office issued a birth certificate for a child named Chagari after six years. The child was born in 2020, and the name was initially deemed illegal. After the parents' complaint and legal procedures, the certificate was issued in August 2025.

Armin, 19, his father Omid, 47, and his uncle Amir, 42, were killed on January 9, 2026, in Fardis. A citizen joined the campaign "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" in their memory. The video was sent to Iran International.
A worker at a stone-cutting factory in Mashhad suffered an accident due to lack of workplace safety. The accident resulted in the amputation of his right leg. This incident occurred yesterday.

The Israeli Prime Minister stated in a meeting that he has the ability to overthrow the Islamic Republic and that this mission is near and achievable. He described the Iranian government as collapsing and weaker than ever. Netanyahu also announced that they have averted the threats posed by the Iranian regime.

Tractor football team remained at the top of the Premier League table after the fifth week despite a draw. Esteghlal and Aluminium Arak both reached 11 points and are in second and third place. Five matches ended in draws this week, showing a cautious approach by teams.

The US State Department's "Rewards for Justice" program announced a reward of up to $10 million for information on Amir Yaryab, head of cyber operations in the IRGC's Cyber-Electronic Command. The program stated on X that Yaryab organizes and directs malicious cyber groups like "Shahid Hemmat" and "Shahid Shushtari" to target critical US infrastructure.

A severe storm on Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar, flooded streets and damaged buildings in the Greater Toronto Area, Canada. Images from Brampton, Vaughan, and Toronto show submerged cars and debris from damaged buildings. Police are assisting occupants of a vehicle trapped in a flooded tunnel.
Omid Chaubaz and Hadi Bayzidi, two citizens from Bukan, were released from the city's prison on bail.

JD Vance, the US Vice President, discussed two options faced by Trump in the Persian Gulf: leaving the region or preventing an energy crisis caused by Iran. Gulf countries consider US withdrawal the worst outcome. Vance emphasized that the US is working to prevent a global energy crisis and has been successful so far.

JD Vance, the US Vice President, stated that the US will not negotiate with the Islamic Republic until attacks on commercial ships stop. The US message to the Islamic Republic is clear: they must cease these attacks. The US plans to use its tools to address the nuclear threat and ensure global energy markets are properly supplied.

The Vice President for Women and Family Affairs stated that the traffic police are obligated to issue motorcycle licenses to women based on a Cabinet resolution. This resolution was approved last February but has not yet been implemented in practice. The police have not yet started issuing motorcycle licenses to women.

FIFA submitted legal documents to a US court to reject UEFA's request for access to documents related to the canceled plan to sell 20% of FIFA's new commercial company. UEFA accused Gianni Infantino of criminal mismanagement and setting prices outside market norms. FIFA stated the plan was only a proposal and could proceed only with majority support from member federations.
A shopkeeper sent a video to Iran International comparing his shop's prices with last year. He shows that prices have increased several times. The video highlights a significant price increase.

One-dollar coins featuring the image of US President Donald Trump were released on Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar, in rolls and bags. The coins were minted for the 250th anniversary of US independence in 2026. One side features Trump's image alongside the words 'Liberty', 'In God We Trust', and the years '1776-2026', while the other side bears the presidential seal and the number '250'.

On September 2nd, a group of military personnel housing applicants in Kermanshah held a protest. The gathering took place at the cooperative of the 81st Armored Division of the army. The protesters demanded attention to their housing issues.

Trump stated that they have enough ammunition to continue the war with Iran. These remarks were made in the audio version of the program 24 with Fardad Farahzad. The topic of war and military equipment was discussed.

CENTCOM announced that by September 2nd, US forces have redirected 87 commercial ships, disabled three ships, and inspected two ships to ensure the full enforcement of the maritime blockade against Iran. These actions are part of the US naval blockade in the region. The USS John Paul Jones destroyer continues to support this blockade.

On Thursday, 12 Shahrivar, a large explosion occurred near the port of Sochi in southwestern Russia. On Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar, Ukraine officially informed ICAO that Russian airspace is not safe. This announcement followed increased Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian territory.

Shayan Samiei said the Islamic Republic is trying to push Gulf countries to mediate and pressure the US by increasing tensions and attacking their interests. He added that the Islamic Republic cannot confront the US directly and seeks to regionalize the conflict. Samiei warned that continuing these attacks may push Gulf countries closer to the United States.

A citizen from Mashhad says they wait in line for gasoline overnight to use their quota for work during the day. This was reported in a video to Iran International. People are trying to obtain their gasoline quota.

Alireza Nourizadeh said that US economic pressures and the Islamic Republic's failure to gain China's support have intensified internal disputes over how to deal with Washington. He added that part of the establishment sees compromise as the solution, but another faction insists on continuing confrontation. Nourizadeh also said that if the US seeks the support of the Iranian people, it must demonstrate this support in action.

Pouya Idani, the Iranian chess grandmaster, has changed his federation to France. He cited unfulfilled promises and unpaid rewards by the Iranian Chess Federation as reasons for this decision. FIDE has confirmed the change, and Idani is now ranked fourth in France.

Nouri al-Maliki opposed disarming armed groups in Iraq and called for organizing and controlling weapons instead of handing them over. He stated that after the deadline, armed groups will not surrender their weapons. This stance conflicts with the Iraqi government's plan to monopolize weapons under government control.

The spokesperson of the Iranian Pharmacists Association stated that using alternative routes for raw material supply and imports may increase drug prices up to three times. Issues such as currency shortage, insurance companies' debts, and rising production costs have seriously threatened the drug market. These problems pose a crisis for the future of the drug market.

Javidnam Ali Ayazi, a 19-year-old footballer, was killed on the evening of Thursday, January 8, 2026, during the National Iranian Revolution in Isfahan by gunfire from the Islamic Republic's suppression forces. His mother commemorated him by sharing pictures and mentioning his love for the Esteghlal team. Ali Ayazi was a former player of Sepahan youth football teams.

Alireza Kiani stated in the program "Fereydoun" that Iranian postmodern feminism did not accept the slogan "Woman, Life, Freedom / Man, Homeland, Prosperity" during the Mahsa uprising. He described this approach as influenced by Western postmodernism. Kiani also said this feminism views men as carriers of gender domination.

Charles III said in a meeting with Pakistan's Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi that everything is going backward regarding the Iran-US conflict. He mentioned that they will have to rely heavily on Pakistan. The Pakistani minister described the situation as a story of one step forward and one step back.

The 83rd Venice Film Festival began with George Clooney receiving an honorary Golden Lion award. Clooney addressed issues such as media concentration among the wealthy and the political situation in the US. Two Iranian films, "Moragheb" and "Kami Noor," are also present at this festival.

Alireza Kiani stated in the program 'Fereydoun' that Iran is not a laboratory for postmodern leftist theories. He added that Iranians are seeking to reclaim their country during the national revolution. He also referred to the 1979 disaster and Michel Foucault's view on it.

The New York Post reported on Thursday, 12 Shahrivar, quoting a senior regional official, that Oman has rejected the Islamic Republic's proposal for joint collection of service fees from commercial ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz. The official said Muscat did not even agree to voluntary collection of environmental and security fees. A US official also said that the terms of the proposed agreement between Iran and Oman for revenue sharing have not been finalized.

Donald Trump stated that the US has full control over the Strait of Hormuz and targets 30 to 40 Iranian boats every night. He also said Iran's economy is collapsing with inflation possibly reaching 300 percent. Trump claimed Iran was only two to four weeks away from obtaining nuclear weapons.

Reuters reported that the US naval blockade and sanctions have severely limited Iran's access to international financial networks. The cost of public necessities has sharply increased, and Iran's gasoline reserves have dropped to about two months. The commander of the IRGC emphasized retaliation against the US attack, while Ali Motahari considered returning to the agreement the best solution.

A human rights group in Iran filed a criminal complaint with the German Federal Prosecutor General, requesting a structural investigation into alleged crimes against humanity in Iran. Simultaneously, a meeting was held in Berlin with lawyers and human rights experts to explore legal avenues for holding perpetrators accountable. The complaint is based on Article 7 of the German International Crimes Act and is supported by extensive documentation.

Dan Brouillette, former US Energy Secretary, said in an interview with Fox Business that intensifying economic pressure on the Islamic Republic could ultimately lead to the collapse of the Iranian regime. Pointing to the high-risk situation in the Strait of Hormuz, he added that with continued economic blockade, the day will come when this regime collapses and the strait opens for trade. Larry Kudlow also said Iran's oil exports have practically reached near zero.

Amir Giti, a member of the Iran International editorial board, said that Washington, by conditioning any negotiations on stopping the Islamic Republic's attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, seeks to remove this leverage from Tehran before talks begin. American officials believe the Islamic Republic should not be able to gain concessions by threatening shipping and security in the Strait of Hormuz. Economic pressures and the military option remain on the table, and new measures will be announced in the coming weeks.

Ben Sabti said Israel's control over the heights overlooking southern Lebanon enables monitoring movements and cutting Hezbollah's logistical lines. This limits the transfer of forces, ammunition, and weapons of Hezbollah. Additionally, the reduction of financial resources of the Islamic Republic has weakened Hezbollah's capabilities.

The Canadian federal government has extended the temporary exemption of indirect taxes on gasoline, diesel, and aviation fuel until the end of January 2027. This decision was made in response to rising oil prices to reduce pressure on consumers and businesses. The report was provided by Mahsa Mortazavi from Iran International.

Family and friends of Ali Abazari gathered at his grave in Behesht Zahra instead of celebrating his birthday at home or a cafe. Ali was an 18-year-old accounting student who was killed by security forces while returning from protests. The gathering was held in memory of him and his short life.

Donald Trump said in an interview with GB News that US military actions against Iran are linked to UK security, and Washington is saving Britain by preventing Tehran from obtaining nuclear weapons. He claimed the US has broken Iran's navy, air force, and command structure and controls the Strait of Hormuz, which is vital for UK energy. Trump also criticized the UK's level of cooperation with US operations and said military and economic pressure on Tehran is part of an effort to eliminate threats.

Donald Trump stated that the US continuously monitors activities related to Iran's nuclear facilities. He said that three nuclear sites in Iran have been completely destroyed and the US has cameras over these areas. Trump added that Washington has full knowledge of movements and detailed information in these regions.

Yemen's legitimate government forces recaptured military positions in the Al-Tuwair front in the Maqbanah area of Taiz province from the Houthis. Clashes between government forces and Houthis continue in the Jabal Dabas axis. This report was published by Al Hadath.
